repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 30-second sustained wait (30 SEC) before acting. The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30 ticks. This causes the action to fire at t=29000 ms (after 30 iterations of 1000 ms each), whereas the IR fires at t=30000 ms (30 seconds). The mismatch is due to the off-by-one error in counting ticks for a sustained duration when the wrapper period is coarse (1000 ms) versus the required duration (100 ticks of 100 ms).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period to 100 ms to align with the standard tick-based counting for sustained conditions. Updated the threshold from 30 to 31 (30 seconds / 100 ms + 1) so the action fires exactly after 30 full seconds of sustained input, matching the IR specification.
